messages:
maya: Dropping a short thread to finish relnotes for the docs release (v0.11.0). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012. Need 3 bullets, one migration line, and any known issues.
drew: I'll add the py/js SDK snippets (1-3 lines each) and a tiny migration note about the streaming default flip.
sophia: Adding Known Issue: embeddings can 429 under sustained high concurrency with Dedicated burst enabled. Repro included in PR: `wrk -t8 -c150 -d30s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings`. Mitigation: client retry/backoff or route to a non-burst pool.
drew: I'll also swap the expired gist in examples/prefix-cache.md to an inline repo sample. Keeping examples <=6 lines.
link-bot: Detected broken anchor in guides/rollouts.md#canary -> should be #canary-deploy. Suggest patching before merge.
docs-bot: CI queued on PR#1012: link-check, snippet-lint, build. Results in ~5m.
maya: TL;DR for announcement (one sentence): "v0.11.0 1: improved streaming and batching, plus small SDK changes; see migration notes."
sophia: Also adding a short note for Dedicated customers about staged canary rollouts and automatic fallback when burst is exhausted.
drew: Pushed small anchor and example fixes to the branch. Assign reviews: @sophia @drew. If CI green, merge tomorrow 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: CI: link-check OK, snippet-lint OK, build OK.
maya: Thanks all. Final merge scheduled 09:00 PT unless someone objects. :tada:
